findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_apis" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search across 484 endpoints in 59 APIs (cultural, earth, energy-calc, green-path, harmonias, hydrogen, internal, nanobase, nanosnap, natura, platform, sakurahub…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
